comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: If used in Original tech creation as the base skill, you can end up with an original skill that grants "Total evasion" status. It only affects the user, unless other techs are added to raise the red "Range" icon from 0 to an actual number; the higher the number, the greater the range, meaning you can help others nearby receive this effect as well. The effect's duration depends "Activation time"; D is least, S is longest.

comments.author: Almeida
comments.body: Acquired this from L15 Guyce Gang, Paphos Outskirts
